title: Co-op, any combination (0.9.171-dev6): player 2 on the Arisen, player 1 keeps the camera
intro: Two controllers (both awake), two pairs of hands. Open ground, no enemies, a full party (two pawns), playing the Arisen, co-op off. Press any button on each controller now so neither is asleep. About 3 minutes. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

steps.text: Get ready: two controllers in two pairs of hands, co-op off. Press End.
PLAYER 1: press something on your controller. PLAYER 2: hold L3 + R3 until 'player 2 joined'. Then each walk your own character for a moment.
PLAYER 1 (on the Arisen): press L1 + left stick click. You should take a pawn, and the Arisen goes on his AI. Both walk around for a bit.
Each controller only works its own pawn? Both attack and use a skill. Camera follows player 1's pawn and keeps player 2 in view?
PLAYER 2: press L1 + left stick click a few times: through the free pawns to the Arisen (player 1's pawn is skipped). Stop when player 2 is the Arisen.

expect.label: player 2 drives the Arisen through DPC (player 1 keeps the camera)

steps.text: Player 2 on the Arisen: PLAYER 2 walks, attacks and uses a skill. PLAYER 1 turns the camera with the right stick. Camera stays with player 1? Player 2 moves the Arisen? 20 seconds.

expect.label: player 2's controller drives the Arisen every frame
the Arisen is on player 2's input
no errors in player 2's Arisen input

steps.text: PLAYER 1: press L1 + left stick click a few times. You go through the free pawns only: the Arisen is player 2's and is skipped.
PLAYER 2: press L1 + left stick click once: player 2 leaves the Arisen for a free pawn.
PLAYER 1: press L1 + left stick click until you are the Arisen (he is free now).
Either player: hold L3 + R3 for 3 seconds to end co-op.
Done. Tell Claude: camera with player 1 the whole time? Player 2's Arisen: moves, attacks, skills, lock-on? Sound with the camera pulled back?

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.cerrs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/CameraDistance.json'); return ok and d and d.errors

probes.who: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local c = D and D.R.cp; if not (c and c.on) then return 'off' end; local n = c.names or {}; return 'P1 ' .. tostring(n[1]) .. ' / P2 ' .. tostring(n[2])
probes.s2a: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.s2.active == true
probes.s2f: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.s2.frames or 0
probes.s2e: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and ((D.R.s2.errors or 0) + ((D.R.s2.in_err and 1) or 0) + ((D.R.s2.failed and 100) or 0)) or 0
probes.s2err: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.R.s2.err or D.R.s2.in_err or '')
probes.s2idx: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.s2.active and D.R.s2.idx or -1
probes.s2on: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.s2.last_on or 0
probes.s2tgt: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.s2.tgt_sets or 0
probes.poss: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.state.active == true
probes.mainidx: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.active and D.state.pawn_idx or -1
probes.coopjs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and string.format('%s pawn %s anchor %s', tostring(d.active), tostring(d.pawn_idx), tostring(d.anchor_idx))
probes.brain: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.brain.on == true
probes.shots: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and ((b.presses or 0) + (b.skill_uses or 0)) or 0

probes.ai1: local p = H.pawn(1); local ok, v = pcall(function() return p:call('get_AIDecisionMaker'):call('get_DecisionModule'):call('get_IsSkipThink') end); return ok and v
probes.camt: local ok, n = pcall(function() local m = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController', 0); return m:call('get_TargetObject'):call('get_Name') end); return ok and n
probes.cplog: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local L = D and D.R.cp.log; return L and L[#L]
probes.s2drv: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local s = D and D.R.s2; return s and string.format('%s hook %d in %d mir %d', s.drive_pre and 'pre' or 'player', s.hook_frames or 0, s.hook_input or 0, s.mirror_input or 0)
probes.ar2: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.cp.ar2 == true

probes.bmode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.brain.mode)
probes.ar2err: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.R.cp.ar2_err or '')
